thread:
Sam (Support): Customer reporting sudden spike of 504s and request timeouts on hosted API. They said it started ~09:12 UTC. Customer call in 30m, P1. @oncall-bot please escalate
Eve (Eng-SRE): I'm looking. Gateway shows 504s and backend pools flapping during scale-up. Correlates with autoscaler events.
Jon (Eng-Platform): Preliminary: KEDA ScaledObject triggered but HPA minReplicaCount stayed at 1. KEDA pollingInterval=30s and cooldownPeriod=30s in prod for these scaledobjects. Might be too slow for a sudden burst.
Priya (Customer Success): Customer says request times out ~15s and they see 5xx for ~20% of calls. Provided request id: req_0a1b2c.
Sam (Support): Pasting gateway/scale logs I grabbed:
```
[2026-03-10T09:12:33Z] gateway: upstream timeout 15s -> 504, tenant=acme-corp request=req_0a1b2c
[2026-03-10T09:12:40Z] autoscaler: scaleup requested for pool model-xx, targetReplicas=3
[2026-03-10T09:12:55Z] kubelet: pod/model-xx-2 readiness probe failed: model-init not ready (timeout)
```
Eve (Eng-SRE): Readiness probe failing while model weights download + quant init are running. Warmstart cache wasn't populated so init is blocking serving process for ~20-30s.
Jon (Eng-Platform): KEDA controller logs show: 
```
ScaledObject 'model-xx-so' trigger=http activation=1 -> request scale to 3
HPA update error: 409 Conflict (object was modified)
```
Maria (SRE): 409 on HPA updates can cause stalls: controllers retry/backoff and HPA stays stale. Combined with long model-init readiness, requests queue and gateway times out. Also saw occasional image pull delays for model wheel files.
Priya (Customer Success): Customer wants ETA and workaround. They are on hosted inference default tier.
Eve (Eng-SRE): Short-term mitigations we can do now: route this tenant to a smaller model variant (model-xx-small) or to Dedicated pool if available; both avoid long init times. Also bump prewarm/minReplicas for this tenant.
Jon (Eng-Platform): I can flip routing via feature flag to model-xx-small for acme-corp. Doing the change now.
oncall-bot: Routing change submitted: route/acme-corp -> model-xx-small (change id: ch_4821). Auto-rollback in 30m unless confirmed.
Sam (Support): Customer confirms lower latency after switch :thumbsup:
Eve (Eng-SRE): Root cause summary: (1) KEDA <> HPA race: concurrent updates caused 409s and delayed HPA apply; (2) default minReplicaCount too low for bursty tenants; (3) models without warm cache have long model-init/readiness leading to probe timeouts.
Jon (Eng-Platform): Long-term fixes I'm proposing:
- Lower KEDA pollingInterval to 5s for scaledObjects flagged as bursty and increase cooldownPeriod to 60s to avoid flapping
- Increase default minReplicaCount for heavy-model pools or make it tenant-configurable
- Use server-side apply / add HPA update retry logic to reduce 409-induced stalls
- Implement prewarm cache/priming for large models and surface a "warm" metric
- Add alert when readiness probe duration > 10s for model-serving pods
Priya (Customer Success): Please send a short summary and the rollback steps so I can update the customer. Also schedule a follow-up with the customer in 48h.
Eve (Eng-SRE): Created INF-4521 with reproduction steps, logs, mitigation applied (routing flag), and proposed platform changes. I also added a runbook snippet for CS to route to fallback: 
```
1) feature-flag set route/<tenant> -> <fallback-model>
2) wait 2 minutes and confirm success rates > 99%
3) escalate to Eng if not recovered
```
Jon (Eng-Platform): Opening PR to change defaults + add runbook. Will include automated test that simulates rapid activation spikes.
Sam (Support): Thanks all. Marking P1 -> monitoring; leaving follow-up to PR and postmortem. Closing thread after postmortem posted.
Eve (Eng-SRE): Posting summary to #incidents and scheduling postmortem.
Maria (SRE): Also adding a short-term knob for CS to request "prewarm" for tenant pools until prewarm automation lands.
Priya (Customer Success): Got it — I'll update the customer and confirm the follow-up meeting.
Sam (Support): resolved for now, monitoring.
